latestVersion.changelog: Connects to NSE/BSE via Yahoo Finance and NSE public APIs (no API key needed). Delivers a 9:15 AM WhatsApp briefing with Nifty/Sensex, your watchlist, top gainers/losers, and Moneycontrol headlines. Set price alerts by just saying "alert me if Reliance crosses ₹3,000."
